title: Cash Pickup Availability Timing: Business Days, Cut-Offs, Notice and Weekend Payout
content:
Five timing figures govern when a Cash Pickup transfer can be collected:

- the Paloma business days from release to the money being available;
- the latest US Central time on a business day for release to count from that day;
- the business days of advance notice a payout branch needs before a large cash payout;
- whether the payout network pays on Saturdays, Sundays and local holidays;
- whether the tier carries Paloma's on-time promise, under which the transfer fee is refunded when the money is made available after its disclosed date for a reason on Paloma's side.

| Cash Pickup tier | Business days from release to availability | Release cut-off (US Central) | Advance-notice business days | Pays on weekends and local holidays | On-time promise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cash Pickup Economy | 1 | 15:00 | 0 | yes | yes |
| Cash Pickup Express | 0 (within minutes of release) | around the clock, every day | 0 | yes | yes |
| Cash Pickup Express Plus | 0 (within minutes of release) | around the clock, every day | 0 | yes | yes |
| Cash Pickup Bank Branch | 0 (within minutes of release) | 13:00 | 0 | no | yes |
| Cash Pickup Cardless ATM | 0 (within minutes of release) | around the clock, every day | 0 | yes | yes |
| Cash Pickup Large Amount | 0 (within minutes of release) | 12:00 | 1 | no | yes |

## Notes

- A figure of 0 business days means the money is available within minutes of release.
- "Around the clock, every day" means the tier has no cut-off, and release counts from the moment it happens.
- Only Cash Pickup Large Amount needs advance notice, of 1 business day.
- Cash Pickup Bank Branch and Cash Pickup Large Amount do not pay on Saturdays, Sundays or local holidays. Every other tier does.
- Every Cash Pickup tier carries the on-time promise.
